error_message: build_plugin.cmd: 'The system cannot find the path specified' after 'where cl.exe'; MSBuild never ran
root_cause: for /f usebackq over vswhere.exe silently fails (the ')' in the expanded %ProgramFiles(x86)% breaks cmd's for-parsing), so MSBUILD fell back to a hardcoded C:\ BuildTools path that doesn't exist on this machine (VS2022 Community is on F:)
fix: build_plugin.cmd: capture vswhere output via temp file + set /p instead of for /f; added existence-checked fallbacks for BuildTools (C:) and Community (F:) and a loud error when none found

error_message: fatal error C1083: Cannot open include file: 'boost/unordered_map.hpp'
root_cause: third_party/KenshiLib_deps/boost_1_60_0 contained only boost.zip (git-lfs artifact, never extracted); the deps repo's Setup.bat does the extraction but was never run

error_message: fatal error C1083: Cannot open include file: 'kenshi/CombatClass.h'
root_cause: KenshiLib_deps HEAD (b566d74 'Update KenshiLib to 0.4.0') moved CombatClass.h into kenshi/combat/; KenshiCoop's code uses the 0.3.0 flat layout
fix: pin deps clone to e75769b (0.3.0 layout + boost env fix): git -C third_party/KenshiLib_deps checkout e75769b; documented in third_party/kenshilib_patches/README.md

error_message: error C2011: 'BuildingDesignation' enum type redefinition (Platoon.h vs Building/Building.h); error C2027: use of undefined type 'CraftingItem' in std::deque member (CraftingBuilding.h)
root_cause: KenshiLib 0.3.0/0.4.0 headers ship an identical enum defined in two headers, and a deque member of a forward-declared-only type; VC10 rejects both. Upstream maintainer evidently builds against a locally-fixed deps copy that was never published
fix: local deps patches: shared include guard around both enum copies; opaque placeholder body for CraftingItem (plugin verified to never touch it). Captured as third_party/kenshilib_patches/0001-vc10-header-fixes.patch with README

error_message: Join stuck at 'connected to peer' - host log: two LOCAL-SAVE edges same tick (autosave2 bootstrap + coop_risk), QUIESCED timeout files=0 on coop_risk, 'XFER-BEGIN refused: no folder coop_risk' - save push never reached the join
root_cause: checkpoint-on-risk consumed a PRE-CONNECT risk edge the instant g_peerPresent flipped true, queueing a second engine save in the same tick as the connect-push bootstrap bake; the engine performs one deferred save, and the single savexfer quiescence watch was re-armed onto the never-written coop_risk folder, so the bootstrap GO/transfer never fired
fix: Plugin.cpp tickCoordinatedSaveLoad: risk save now requires the peer present >= 60 s (RISK_PEER_SETTLE_MS) and !g_bootstrapArmed, in addition to the existing !watching/!savePending gates; stale edge stays pending and fires later if still relevant

error_message: Risk checkpoints fired once per connection then never again (host log: 20 NEW-SQUAD cohorts pending, zero RISK-CHECKPOINT lines)
root_cause: gate used g_savePending.empty() as 'no save in flight', but g_savePending is only cleared by the bootstrap-GO and mid-session-load paths - a normal QUIESCED->beginSend transfer leaves it set forever, so the gate stayed false after the first risk save

error_message: Buildings placed by the host never appeared for the join (zero [build] PLACE lines all session; latejoin RESYNC place=0)
root_cause: placeFinalPreviewBuilding is a VIRTUAL; the detour hooks only the base impl (wall/gate previews override it), and the hook's hand-resolve failure path returned silently. No capture -> nothing streamed
fix: Three-part: (1) hook logs every invocation incl. refused/unresolved; (2) placement-capture fallback census in publishBuilds - incomplete-site census diffs vs a session baseline, new non-proxy non-announced sites queue fromUi=2 edges; (3) applyBuilds dup guard - announced keys that resolve locally (shared baked sites) map instead of minting a duplicate

error_message: [money] SEND cats=0 on BOTH clients all session while players held real money; no money ever crossed
root_cause: protocol-22 read the Ownerships::money block via the platoon walk; on real saves that storage reads 0 - Character::getMoney (the engine's own display/spend read) is the canonical getter
fix: readWalletByHand prefers Character::getMoney (one-shot probe logs both sources); writeWalletByHand = verify ladder: Ownerships::setMoney -> read back via getMoney -> apply remaining delta via Character::takeMoney -> loud log if still mismatched

error_message: Ground-gear ghost/dup (original 2026-07-21 report): picking up save-native or NPC-shed gear left the peer's copy on the ground (PICKUP-APPLY ref=0/0 moved=0), pickable again = item duplication
root_cause: pre-existing ground gear is tracked by NEITHER item channel (W1 world channel excludes gear via isGearType; W2 weapon census only tracks session drops from tracked inventories), so peer pickups carry no identity and the apply side had nothing to remove
fix: apply-side spatial fallback: when ref=0/0 AND zero tracked same-sid copies exist (identity system has nothing to protect), engine::findGroundItemBySidNear finds the nearest FREE same-sid ground item within 80u of the picker and re-homes it via addItemPtrToInventory. Logged as ghostFb=1 in PICKUP-APPLY. Tracked duplicates keep the strict never-guess rule
